scripts.generate: go tool templ generate && go tool sqlc generate && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run generate && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR="$PWD/.libvips" go run ./cmd/server
scripts.format: prettier --write . && gofmt -w cmd internal web && go tool templ fmt -prettier-required internal/views
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run check:js && npm run check:go
scripts.check:go: ! gofmt -l cmd internal web | grep . && go tool templ fmt -fail -prettier-required internal/views && PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR="$PWD/.libvips" go vet ./...
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:go && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:go: npm run generate && PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR="$PWD/.libvips" go test ./...
scripts.test:e2e: npm run generate && PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR="$PWD/.libvips" go build -o .e2e/server ./cmd/server && go build -o .e2e/migrate ./cmd/migrate && playwright test
